title: codemeld settings.yaml
description: Canonical shape of ~/.codemeld/global/settings.yaml and per-project .codemeld/settings.yaml. Every key with a runtime hard-coded default is optional, so an empty document {} validates. The built-in provider id openai-chatgpt is reserved (a user-defined provider.openai-chatgpt entry is rejected) and auth.openai-chatgpt holds the codemeld-owned ChatGPT session; auth is global-only.

attribution.description: Whether outbound OpenRouter chat-completion requests identify codemeld via the HTTP-Referer and X-Title headers. Defaults to true when omitted, is global-only (a per-project settings file carrying it fails to load), and affects no other provider. The settings tab of the /permissions overlay toggles it.

declared_commands.description: Project-layer-only list of approved direct-command token prefixes Auto mode consults without prompting. Each entry authorizes any invocation whose canonical command tokens begin with it at a token boundary, on the direct route only, and only when that invocation carries no leading environment assignment and does not clear the environment. Rejected in the global settings file.

blocked_paths.description: Files and folders codemeld's tools and confined commands may neither read nor write. Each entry is an absolute path or a ~-relative path. Accepted in both the global and the project settings file; entries from every file are combined, so no file can remove another file's entries.

writable_folders.description: Project-settings-only list of declared folder strings. Entries are parsed and validated as absolute folders (including expanded ~-relative paths), and invalid paths are skipped with notices, but the entries do not yet widen what Auto may write. Rejected in the global settings file.

web_research.description: Web-research settings. Global-only: any occurrence in a per-project settings file is rejected at load. enabled is on by default and only advertises the web tools: advertising authorizes no request, so every call still needs a prompt answer or a grant. api_key is the user's optional Exa key, max_results bounds requested candidates, and timeout_seconds bounds one search or fetch request. Configuration authorizes no host and initiates no request.

confinement.description: Global-only confinement settings: any occurrence in a per-project settings file is rejected at load. program_lookup chooses where confined programs are found (friendly, the default, uses the PATH codemeld launched with; strict uses only the fixed system PATH). shared_temp_folders is the saved answer to whether confined commands may write to the shared temp folders; absent means not yet answered.

retryConfig.description: Transient-failure auto-retry. Reserved config under `provider` (not a provider entry): enabled toggles auto-retry, max_attempts caps total attempts including the first, and base_delay_ms/max_delay_ms bound the exponential backoff.

providerEntry.description: A configured provider entry: connection configuration only (base_url, api_key, optional auth_header). The openrouter entry is the one exception: it also accepts an optional `routing` block (see openrouterProviderEntry). Selectable model ids come solely from the system-owned discovered cache (models.yaml), refreshed by /connect. The retired `models` key is rejected; no migration or compatibility parsing is provided.

openrouterProviderEntry.description: The openrouter provider entry: connection configuration (base_url, api_key, optional auth_header) plus an optional `routing` block of OpenRouter provider-routing preferences sent with every request. Selectable model ids come solely from the system-owned discovered cache (models.yaml), refreshed by /connect. The retired `models` key is rejected; no migration or compatibility parsing is provided.

openrouterRouting.description: OpenRouter provider-routing preferences. sort picks providers by throughput or latency instead of OpenRouter's default price-weighted routing, or best_value tries the cheapest providers first and moves providers slower than the median speed for the model to the end; data_collection deny restricts routing to providers that do not store or train on prompts; require_parameters true restricts routing to providers that support every request parameter; max_price caps, per exact model id, the prompt and completion price (US dollars per million tokens) a provider may charge. Absent keys keep OpenRouter's defaults.

max_price.description: Per-model price caps keyed by the exact OpenRouter model id; a suffixed id such as `:free` or `:nitro` is a separate key. Each entry sets prompt, completion, or both.

modelFavorite.description: One favorited provider/model pair, in user-chosen order. Reasoning effort is not part of a favorite because it stays a per-selection picker control.

permissionEntry.description: One persisted grant, in exactly one of two disjoint shapes. A command/filesystem grant carries path_scope with grant_kind folder or global. A network grant carries host_scope instead: kind tool, subject web_search or web_fetch, one exact non-wildcard host, and grant_kind project, which is valid only in a project's .codemeld/settings.yaml.
